Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=total_revenue DESC]
    Project[part.brand AS brand, line_count, total_qty, total_revenue, avg_discount]
      Filter[sum(lineitem.quantity) > 50]
        Aggregate[group=part.brand, aggs=count(*) AS line_count, sum(lineitem.quantity) AS total_qty, sum(lineitem.extended_price) AS total_revenue, avg(lineitem.discount) AS avg_discount]
          Filter[orders.order_status = 'O' AND part.size > 5]
            Join[kind=inner, cond=lineitem.part_id = part.id]
              Join[kind=inner, cond=lineitem.order_id = orders.id]
                Scan[lineitem]
                Scan[orders]
              Scan[part]
